logging/queue#

Writing records in the background through a bounded queue.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let queued = QueuedLogs(origin: TextStreamLogs(file), capacity: 1024, overflow: LogOverflow.drop_oldest, scope: scope);
…
await queued.drain();

Description#

Writing records in the background through a bounded queue.

When the queue is full a record is refused, dropped or pushes out the oldest, as overflow says; dropped_records() counts them.
